stories.title: President Trump expands AI data center ‘ratepayer protection pledge’ to include state governors and utility companies — White House claims this will make electricity more affordable

sources.title: President Trump expands AI data center ‘ratepayer protection pledge’ to include state governors and utility companies — White House claims this will make electricity more affordable
sources.title_en: President Trump expands AI data center ‘ratepayer protection pledge’ to include state governors and utility companies — White House claims this will make electricity more affordable
sources.title_original: President Trump expands AI data center ‘ratepayer protection pledge’ to include state governors and utility companies — White House claims this will make electricity more affordable
sources.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump expands the 'ratepayer protection pledge' to include states, utility companies, and data center developers. He claims that the pledge will help electricity costs go down, even as PJM Interconnect, the largest grid operator in the U.S., increased power costs by 75.5% and slapped Maryland with a $2-billion bill for infrastructure upgrades.
sources.summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将“纳税人保护承诺”扩大到包括各州、公用事业公司和数据中心开发商。他声称，这一承诺将有助于降低电力成本，尽管美国最大的电网运营商 PJM Interconnect 将电力成本增加了 75.5%，并向马里兰州支付了 20 亿美元的基础设施升级费用。
